name: Root Cause Analysis
description: Follow the evidence from the symptom to a cause, and stop when the chain is incomplete.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read a project file that the question depends on.
Find the code or docs that the question is about.
Read logs that are already captured for this incident.

validation.rule: A root cause is named only when the evidence chain connects it to the symptom. An incomplete chain is reported as incomplete.
